title: 344 Things Could Have Killed the James Webb Telescope

scenes.text: 344 things could have destroyed this telescope.
NASA's James Webb Space Telescope had 344 single points of failure.
That means 344 parts where one failure could end the whole mission.
It had to unfold itself in space, nearly a million miles from anyone who could fix it.
The unfolding took about thirty days, and the first two and a half weeks were the scariest.
344 ways to fail. And it worked.

description:
